about: A box a person signs in with a mouse, a pen or a finger, with a guide line to sign on and a button that clears the strokes. The pad keeps the strokes as SVG path data, and a form receives them as an SVG image cropped to the signature.

consent.about: The field requires a signature, so submitting a blank pad shows the error text. The pad submits its signature under `name` as an SVG data URL, and `onDrawEnd` reports each stroke.
consent.title: Required in a form

download.about: `onDrawEnd` passes `getDataUrl`, which renders the strokes as a PNG. The download trigger saves it once something is drawn. The image inks the strokes in black unless `drawing.fill` states a color.
download.title: Download

lease: Sign as on your passport. Your signature is added to the lease.

palette.about: The palette the strokes fill in. The default, `neutral`, reads as ink on the pad in both color modes.
palette.title: Palettes

pen.about: `drawing` passes the stroke options to the machine: `size` sets the width, and `simulatePressure` thins a fast stroke and thickens a slow one.
pen.title: Pen

size.about: Every size of the pad. The control is at least 160, 208 or 256px tall, and the clear trigger is the input group's square at the same size.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: An invalid pad, a read-only pad and a disabled one. A read-only pad keeps its strokes and hides the clear trigger, and a disabled pad leaves the tab order.
states.title: States

title: Signature pad

typed.about: Drawing needs a pointer, so the page offers a typed name as the other way to sign. A segment group switches between the pad and a text field.
typed.title: Draw or type

typedHelp: Type your name as it appears on your passport.

undo.about: The caller keeps the strokes in state through `paths` and `onDraw`, so a button outside the pad removes the last stroke.
undo.title: Undo

variant.about: The field's outline and subtle looks. The pad starts with a saved signature and the clear trigger in its corner.
variant.title: Looks
